text: In HoTT, a path p : a = b in A is:
choices: a proof of propositional equality with no further structure
a continuous function [0,1] → A sending 0 to a and 1 to b
a term of the identity type — which IS a path in the homotopy-theoretic sense
an element of the loop space ΩA
explanation: In HoTT, identity types are paths. Proof of a=b ≡ path from a to b. The homotopy interpretation is built into the foundations.
